product.name: Slim Fit Twill Pants
product.description: Slim-fit, ankle-length pants in soft twill with a fitted silhouette. Elasticized, drawstring waistband, mock fly, side-seam pockets, and welt back pockets. Legs with stitched creases and foldover cuffs.
